newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuelan armored car company.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuelan armored car company.

text.p: Pittston Brink's Group said Thursday its Brink's Inc. subsidiary will pay $58 million to acquire nearly all of the remaining shares of the largest armoured car company in Venezuela.
Brink's currently owns 15 percent of the armoured car company Custodia Y Traslado de Valores CA (Custravalca). The deal is scheduled to close in January.
Custravalca has annual revenues of about $70 million. Custravalca also owns a 31 percent stake in Brink's Peru S.A., the largest armoured car company in Peru, Pittston said.
Pittston Brink's said it expected the transaction to boost earnings beginning in 1997.
It said the deal will be financed with borrowings in the Venezuelan markets and possibly participation by local investors in a minority interest in Custravalca.
Pittston Brink's stocks was unchanged at $26.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
